title: Prove one internal gap misses the g=13, q=8 paired star.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Proof, for one schedule. In the paired-star contract, put every thin map between the two halves of stage 0, in either order, and run stages 1 through 12 as adjacent pairs with no further thin maps. If the off-diagonal block `B` is nonzero, the normalized coefficient is not `I`. Its block from leaf `t` into leaf 0 equals `(D_0+1) D_t^{-1} B`.

At `g=13` and `q=8`, the five rank-8 maps forced by setting every `D_j=1` sum to that unique matrix and fail. Both half orders were evaluated at two `GF(16)` points with `D_0≠1`. The pure product is still the target. The failure is the coefficient of `e`.

This is a proof under those hypotheses, with exact finite corroboration. It is not an exhaustive census of interleavings. A failure on this pattern is not unrestricted nonexistence of an interleaved word. Five rank-8 maps have total rank 40, which equals the chronological floor, so that floor does not forbid them. The adjacent-halves count does not apply once a thin map stands between the halves.

No new kappa. The selected frontier stays `781451/250000000 = 0.003125804` from PR #6030.

## Task and overlap

Base commit `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840` (canonical CrocSwap `main`). Fork `main` is older, so this draft uses `cursor/crocswap-main-17469fff-1751`, which is that same commit, as its base. The upstream target is CrocSwap `main`.

Head `99b5ed6d80ca3d97cf5f7176bf8b3557d67662bb`. Package `research/paired-star-g13-q8-internal-gap`.

Task card `joint-query-controller`, scope refined. The assigned question is open next question 1 of PR #7010: one pattern that separates at least one stage's halves, the thin maps forced by every `D_j=1`, and the normalized coefficient at two field points.

Nearest overlap, refreshed 2026-11-10 (`python3 scripts/find_overlap.py --refresh`, 317 open PRs, 6972 discussion records):

- Open PR #7010, head `32999d634cdd718ce6fb77648f54e4e674d7f395`, proves the adjacent-halves count and leaves an interleaved word open. Canonical note: discussion #5593, comment 19507682. Handoff pointer: #1166, comment 19507683.
- Open PR #7005, head `1750566c34c9fb117dc4afc4ce2bdacca7da036b`, proves the consecutive rank bound at `g=31`, `q=26`. Its internal-gap question is that other profile and is not answered here.
- The `g=3` censuses in PR #6922, PR #6940, PR #6956, and open PR #7011 do not lift to thirteen leaves or eight ports.

No open PR in that snapshot proves this first-stage internal gap at `g=13`, `q=8`.

## Validation

Python 3.12, no third-party packages.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-star-g13-q8-internal-gap
```

Registered status: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `negative-result`. Both the plain replay and the `python3 -O -B` replay print `PASS_PAIRED_STAR_G13_Q8_INTERNAL_GAP`. Checks raise, so `-O` does not strip them.

`scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/paired-star-g13-q8-internal-gap --check-source-history --check-modes` passed at `99b5ed6d80ca3d97cf5f7176bf8b3557d67662bb`.

The checker confirms the legal noncommuting pair, the five rank-8 bundles, agreement of the fast updater with the dual-number word, a one-leaf positive control, `S=I` at every `D_j=1`, and the block identity at the two field points in both half orders. An external-gap control keeps the block zero. The `B=0` control keeps it zero as well; that case is the commuting theorem and is not re-proved.

Not run: a search over other patterns, a native or supplier replay, a proof assistant, and `scripts/research_selected_baseline.py`. The selected record is provenance only.

## Credit

The paired-star contract, the rank floor, and the commuting map-count are from PR #5747 (Ali Romman), including PR #5673, PR #5631, and PR #5617. The adjacent-halves count that leaves this pattern open is PR #7010. The consecutive rank bound at the other profile is PR #7005.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Independent human review and a proof-assistant proof are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Can one of the five rank-8 maps sit in the gap after stage 0 and cancel the leaf-0←leaf-1 block, while the sum at every `D_j=1` stays the same swap? Subtract a rank-8 matrix supported on the two leaf-0/leaf-1 blocks of `B` from the internal sum, add it after stage 0, and recompute the block at `D=(2,3,...,14)`.
- Does the same block stay nonzero when stage 0 is not first? Complete stage 1, open stage 0 around the same five maps, and read the leaf-0←leaf-2 block at one point with `D_1≠1`.

A full call of another stage between the halves, and the `g=31`, `q=26` internal gap, are different questions.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The registered replay finishes in about three seconds. The useful split was one declared gap, with the maps fixed by `D_j=1`, rather than a search over patterns.

Feedback discussion: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200
